The '''battle of Chandrila''' was a conflict during the [[First Great Schism]] fought between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and thus, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and the [[Legions of Lettow]], under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]]. Most historians assumed the Jedi were the victors.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Little is known about the battle, though it seems to have take place after the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (First Great Schism)|Battle of Brentaal IV]] and before the [[Battle of Metellos (First Great Schism)|Battle of Metellos]].
